name: rem_dream
description: Periodic REM memory assimilation over recent visible inputs and outputs.
prompt: Assimilate the short-term slice. Search existing LTM before adding. Keep durable facts, prefs, decisions, identities, open work. Drop stale bloat. One JSON line: {"actions":{"ltm_add":["fact"],"ltm_remove":[<ids>],"shared_add":[{"scope":"global|user:<id>|guild:<id>|channel:<id>","content":"fact","importance":1-10}]},"audit":"short summary"}. Empty: {"actions":{},"audit":"no changes"}. audit required.
